fnol_text: My name is Zara Moreau and I live at 858 Cedar Place, Dover, DE 19917. You can reach me on (555) 889-8675 or zara.moreau@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 3 September 2025. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00055. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Can you confirm I'm covered for this?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Moreau on (555) 889-8675 to acknowledge the claim. Zara confirmed the loss date as 3 September 2025.
Site visit to 858 Cedar Place. Neighbour Mateo Ueda was present and confirmed the timeline.
Zara sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
